why: Image 2 puts soft, out-of-focus lounge chairs in the near foreground and has a tighter, less blown-out projected light on the left wall, so it looks like a photographer standing inside a real room rather than a clean overview of a set. The two share the same materials and the same blotchy, smeared floor, but Image 1 leaves a large empty dark foreground and has a big overexposed light spill, which make it read as more of a render.
